result.reason: The transition-assistance obligation reaches the preferred six-month period at then-current rates, and deletion certification is included. However, the data-return obligation does not clearly require export within 30 days after expiry or termination: it runs within 30 days of “such request,” which appears to refer to the transition-assistance request in subsection (i). Data return is therefore potentially conditional on a separate request and may occur well after termination, failing both the preferred and fallback timing position. The addition is otherwise targeted and preserves unrelated terms, but the ambiguous cross-reference reduces drafting quality.
